_about: Which AI models 99ile may use, and the order each task tries them in (docs/design/explain-mistake.md, 'Models and keys'). No secrets here: a provider names the environment variable that holds its keys. Change the summary order on Render without a deploy with AI_SUMMARY (names from 'models', comma separated). A whole other file: AI_CATALOG=path. Medium effort since 14 Nov 2026 (D106): low gave a good summary 4 of 4 and then 1 of 4. qwen/qwen3.8-27b was removed: with strict JSON it looped and Groq refused its reply. Run the eval (go test -tags eval ./internal/ai) before changing a model or a setting.
